title: Doppler-free triage for elevated left atrial pressure from B-mode echocardiographic video (code, v2.1.0)
description: Code, prespecified analysis plan, dated record of deviations and aggregate results for the development of a model estimating elevated left atrial pressure from B-mode echocardiographic video on MIMIC-IV-ECHO, and its zero-shot external validation on EchoXFlow. No restricted or patient-level data are included.
